topic: Fake data breach settlements, and 3 free locks
member_angle: A breach letter or call that asks for your account number or a fee to claim a settlement. Turn it into 3 locks: credit freeze, 2-step login on online banking, card alerts in the app.
season_hook: Data Privacy Day (Jan 28) just passed; W-2 phishing season.

topic: Romance scams and the gift card favor
member_angle: The new online friend asks for gift cards, then a photo of the back of the card. Staff angle: tellers spotting large gift-card buys and repeated wires.

topic: "Hi Mom, this is my new number"
member_angle: Text from a "child" with a new number who needs a bill paid by P2P. Fix: call the old number, agree a family code word.
Preparers who won't sign the return, take a cut of the refund, or route it to their own account. Tell members to deposit refunds only into their own account here.

topic: Government imposters: Social Security numbers don't get "suspended"
member_angle: Calls from "SSA", "Medicare" or "the sheriff" that end with moving money to a "safe account". Promise box: we will never ask you to move money to keep it safe.
season_hook: National Slam the Scam Day, usually the first Thursday of March (Mar 4 2027); confirm on oig.ssa.gov first.

topic: Spring break rentals and March Madness "sure wins"
member_angle: Half-price rental that wants a wire, Zelle or gift card deposit. Pay for travel by card, never P2P to a stranger.
season_hook: Spring break; March Madness starts mid-March.

member_angle: "You qualify for forgiveness, $499 to apply." The help is free at studentaid.gov; never share an FSA ID. Good for young members and parents.
season_hook: Student loan rule changes; FAFSA season.

member_angle: A text says you owe a small toll and links to a pay page that steals card details. Fix: don't tap; check your toll account by typing the address yourself; if you paid, call us to block the card.
season_hook: Spring driving season; recurring smishing wave.

topic: The fake IRS letter that wants a phone call
member_angle: Paper letters with a callback number. Three checks: notice number, look up the number on irs.gov, log in to your IRS online account.

topic: The "government grant" a friend sent you
member_angle: A hacked friend's account offers free grant money for a fee. Call the friend; real grants don't charge fees.
season_hook: Evergreen; a lighter topic between two tax issues.

topic: After you file: the "refund adjustment" text
member_angle: Texts about a changed refund that link to a fake IRS page. One place to check: Where's My Refund on irs.gov.

topic: Payment app scams: "send it back" and "send it to yourself"
member_angle: Overpayment by P2P then "send it back", and fake fraud staff who say to Zelle money "to yourself". Promise box. Reg E note for the staff brief: defer to the credit union's own dispute process.
season_hook: Refund money is in accounts; evergreen.
